input.explanation: The slowness came entirely from average_spend_per_item in src/io_shop/spend_summary.py, which re-summed every prefix of the purchase list. The patch makes it a single pass, so its callers (render_spend_summary and the account page) get the cost back to linear without any other change. The function keeps the same signature, the same result (still worked out from the purchase list) and the same ZeroDivisionError for an account with no purchases. Nothing outside this repository has to change.
